question: Sodium is kept in which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kerosene.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The chemical element sodium has the atomic number 11 and the symbol Na.
 
• It is a delicate, silvery- metal that is exceedingly reactive.
 
• Due to its placement in group 1 of the periodic table, sodium is an alkali metal.
 
• Sodium is a very reactive metal.
 
• Because of how strongly it reacts with oxygen and moisture due to its high reactivity, sodium is stored in kerosene to avoid it coming into contact with these elements.
 
• When it reacts, a strongly exothermic reaction will result.​
